topic: Check refusal notifications in Orch.app by hand
detail: Not verifiable by tests (UNUserNotificationCenter needs the app bundle). With a spaces policy applied and the guard enforcing, run a session call into another job's folder while Orch.app built from PR #179 runs: one 'Tool call refused' notification should appear (subtitle 'space <space> · <tool>', body 'Rule <rule> in session <id>.', no command or path); four or more refusals within 5 s should give one 'N tool calls refused' summary; clicking either should open Settings > Spaces. Refusals made before the app started are not announced.
